Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing an additional tax on cigarettes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing an additional cigarette tax; addinga new section to chapter 82.24 RCW; providing an effective date; anddeclaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to the tax imposed upon the sale, use, consumption,handling, possession, or distribution of cigarettes set forth in RCW82.24.020, there is imposed a tax in an amount equal to the rate ofthirty mills per cigarette. (2) The revenue collected under this section shall be deposited asfollows: (a) 88.4 percent shall be deposited into the health servicesaccount under RCW 43.72.900 and shall be used solely for Washingtonbasic health plan enrollment as provided in chapter 70.47 RCW. (b) 6.5 percent shall be deposited into the general fund. (c) 2.9 percent shall be deposited into the violence reduction anddrug enforcement account under RCW 69.50.520. p. 1 SB 5829 (d) 2.2 percent shall be deposited into the water quality accountunder RCW 70.146.030.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2005.
